messages:
nina (eng-runtime): quick note: after landing the kernel-hint patch we're seeing elevated host-side parse latency on grpc streaming (short requests).

raj (eng-ml): saw the dashboards. p95 up ~3x for seq<32. Any flamegraphs?

kim (perf): captured a short trace. Top shows parse_token + small writev thrash. Kernel hint added a sync path that forces validate->reinit for tokenizer ctx.

nina (eng-runtime): exact repro: curl -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @short.json http://canary:8080/v1/stream -> observe 100-200us extra per-request.

kim (perf): pprof link: https://pprof.internal/5900/parse-writev (internal)

kim (perf): pprof top:
"37.5%  parse_token"
"14.2%  writev/syscall"
"10.1%  kernel_hint::validate"

raj (eng-ml): suspect validate compares full metadata blob now (we added quantization fields). That makes the hash unstable across builds.

nina (eng-runtime): mitigation options:
- revert kernel-hint (fast)
- change validate to compare stable subset (medium)
- keep kernel-hint but cache tokenizer per-host forever (long)

ops-bot: Initiating canary rollback for feature kernel-hint at 09:12. Status: in-progress.

nina (eng-runtime): i'll prepare a small PR to only include stable metadata fields in the hash. Should be <50 LOC.

kim (perf): after rollback started, canary p95 trending down to baseline. I'll run a 5m wrk before we push any further changes.

ops-bot: Rollback completed on canary hosts. Health checks passing.

raj (eng-ml): good. let's hold kernel-hint until PR merged + perf gate. We should also add unit test ensuring metadata-hash stability across optional fields.

nina (eng-runtime): agreed. Action items: revert done, PR for stable-hash, perf CI job for short-stream scenario.

kim (perf): I'll add a p95 regression alert for streaming endpoints tied to kernel-hint PRs.

nina (eng-runtime): thanks team, will update release notes and block rollout.
